notes: Export must be filtered to Record state = 'active' (12 of 24 rows); the 12 'expired' rows must be excluded, leaving one active price per SKU.
SKU values are zero-padded text codes (e.g. 00470001) despite being profiled as int; preserve them as strings and do not let the numeric parse drop leading zeros.

Net price is VAT-exclusive everywhere (Tax included = 'No') and Tax rate is a fictional 5% fixture, so vat_included=false and vat_rate=0.05 rather than the schema's 0.07 default; the 5% is a fixture value, not tax advice.

No 'Valid to' / end-date column exists in this file. Expiry is only implied by the 'expired' Record state and by the later Valid from period (2026-11-01) superseding the earlier one (2026-10-01); /prices/*/effective_to therefore cannot be populated from source evidence and is left unresolved rather than guessed.
Price list and Currency and Sales unit are constant ('standard', 'THB', 'PCS'); no pack_size evidence is present, so /unit/pack_size stays null.

tables.reason: One row per SKU per validity period: SKU + Product name identify the product, while Price list, Net price, Tax included, Tax rate and Valid from describe a dated price record. The Record state column separates 12 active rows from 12 expired rows, and the operator requires only active prices to be exported.

columns.name: SKU
columns.reason: Header 'SKU'; each value repeats exactly twice (once per validity period) across 12 products; values are zero-padded codes such as 00470001 that must be read as text to preserve leading zeros.

columns.name: Product name
columns.reason: Header 'Product name'; 12 distinct descriptive names aligned one-to-one with the 12 SKUs (e.g. 'SIM replenishment 1').

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: Header 'Currency'; single distinct value 'THB', a 3-letter ISO code satisfying the /currency pattern. No FX conversion needed.

columns.name: Sales unit
columns.reason: Header 'Sales unit' matches the unit.sell synonym 'sales unit'; single value 'PCS', already a canonical enum_hint value.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Header 'Price list'; single value 'standard', matching the operator instruction to use price_list 'standard' where explicitly stated.

columns.name: Net price
columns.reason: Header 'Net price' matches the price.amount synonym 'net price'; 24 distinct non-null decimal values in the plausible price range 1134.56–1356.77, one per price record.

columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: Header 'Tax included' is an explicit VAT-inclusion flag; every row is 'No', i.e. the net price is VAT-exclusive, so vat_included=false.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Header 'Tax rate'; single value '5%' for all rows, a fictional fixture rate. Should be converted to the fraction 0.05 rather than assumed to be the default 0.07.

columns.name: Valid from
columns.reason: Header 'Valid from' matches the effective_from synonym 'valid from'; two dates (2026-10-01 and 2026-11-01) partitioning the 24 rows into two validity periods.

columns.name: Record state
columns.reason: Header 'Record state' holds 'active' or 'expired' per price row (12 each). After expired rows are filtered out per the operator requirement, retained rows correspond to active status; because this describes price-record validity rather than product lifecycle, mapping to /status is provisional.
